messages:
ryan: Heads-up: OpalDynamics is eyeing a migration off CloudStream. They want a two-week proof to validate API compatibility (endpoints, headers), response stability for their prompt bank, and cost delta. Can we spin this up?

tamika: We should scope endpoints first. CloudStream uses /v1/text and /v1/dialog with SSE streaming chunks and metadata in 'meta' field. Do we have a translation plan?

leo: Quick plan: gateway adapter that rewrites paths and headers. map Authorization -> x-rk-key, map client-id -> x-customer, and convert SSE events to Redwood streaming events. Streaming format difference is biggest risk.

ana: (typo) ana: How different is their SSE? They emit "chunk","done" events with base64 payloads. Redwood uses newline-delimited JSON with event:message. Converter should be straightforward.

leo: Agree. We'll need to handle partial token boundaries and ensure we don't double-flush. Small CPU overhead but within canary perf.

ryan: Ops question: will this adapter be hot path? We must show latency numbers to their infra lead. Can we bench end-to-end?

infra-bot: Canary created in us-east-1-dedicated, 2x A10s. Baseline synthetic latency (no adapter): 45ms p95. With gateway adapter + streaming transform: 63ms p95. Details in artifact: https://redwood.artifacts/opal/canary-1962239999.json

tamika: Good. Security: they submitted an RFI about data handling, key management, and SOC2 evidence. Also asked about prompt retention and whether we use prompts for model tuning.

security-bot: Short answers: prompt content retention is 14 days by default for troubleshooting; enterprise retention configurable to 365 days. We do not train models on customer data unless explicit opt-in. KMS integration supports customer-managed keys via HSM (BYOK), rotation policy documented. SOC2 Type II report link: https://redwood.docs/sales/opal-soc2.pdf

ryan: Finance asked for a simple comparison: their current vendor pays $0.75 per 1k prompt tokens. Can we estimate hosted vs dedicated for their 6-week POC at 40% utilization?

ana: ana: I'll draft the numbers. Need expected peak qps and avg tokens per call. Ryan can you share the sample telemetry?

ryan: Sent sample telemetry to the presales folder: https://redwood.drive/opal/sample-telemetry.csv

leo: For parity testing we'll run three suites: deterministic (temp=0), stochastic (temp=0.2), and streaming integrity (stop sequences, chunk joins). We'll compare token counts, embs, and safety signals.

tamika: Also include a few 'edge prompts' they flagged: long multi-turn code generation, JSON schema enforcement, and policy-sensitive language. Those are where differences show up.

leo: I'll wire the harness to run 150 prompts overnight. Expect results in morning.

infra-bot: Test job queued as job-9876 at 1962240102. Progress: queued.

infra-bot: Update: job-9876 running 1962240220. 75/150 completed. Found 4 stop-token mismatches in code-gen prompts.

ryan: Noted. Are stop-token semantics configurable at runtime? If yes, great.

leo: Yes, adapter will enforce stop-token semantics and will optionally trim trailing incomplete tokens to match CloudStream behavior. I'll open a small patch.

tamika: Legal wants a snippet for the security questionnaire: "Do you support customer key rotation without service interruption?" What's the concise answer?

security-bot: Answer: Yes. Rolling rotation supported; customers can supply a secondary key for rotation overlap. See KMS rotation playbook: https://redwood.docs/sec/kms-rotation

ana: Pricing sheet draft uploaded: https://redwood.sheets/opal/poc-pricing-v1 (includes hosted per-token, dedicated committed tiers at 50/75/90% util).

ryan: Perfect. Timeline: get adapter PR and test report by Thu EOD, compile security + pricing packet Thu night, demo Fri. Can we hit that?

leo: Will do adapter PR today. Expect perf note and test artifacts.

tamika: I'll assemble the presales brief and include bullet answers to RFI.

infra-bot: job-9876 complete 1962240380. Summary: 146/150 passed deterministic exact-match, 4 stop-token mismatches (code-gen), 2 minor JSON schema formatting differences. Report: https://redwood.artifacts/opal/parity-1962239999.json

leo: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/gateway-adapters/pull/558 1 adds stop-token trimming, streaming reframe. Bench notes included.

security-bot: Uploaded security bundle for OpalDynamics: SOC2, KMS diagrams, rotation playbook, endpoint encryption blackbox test results. Link: https://redwood.docs/sales/opal-security-bundle.zip

ryan: Great. I'll schedule the demo for Fri 10am PT with their CTO and infra lead. Invite going out now.

tamika: One more: Opal asked about EU-only hosting and a private control plane. That will need Dedicated in eu-west-1. Add optional line item to pricing sheet.

ana: Done. Pricing updated to include eu-west-1 dedicated setup cost and monthly committed fees.

ryan: Anything blocking legal or escalation?

tamika: Legal wants an addendum for BYOK SLA and verification steps. I can coordinate their counsel after demo.

leo: No technical blockers left on our side; will monitor the demo feedback and follow up on any parity diffs.

ryan: Thanks team. We'll post post-demo notes here. :thumbsup:
